title: fix(messaging): the one-time digest conversion rewrites only rows that held none before its claim (follow-up of #36326)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pb2t8Z8C64PkPyVt1

Follow-up of PR #36326 (#35123, ruling B 7073270426), carried from contract review 7076382062. Filed under the maintainer's 2026-11-22 07:49Z rule that should-fix items go to their own card.

**S1 (should-fix).** `packages/services/service-messaging/src/preference-digest-conversion.ts`: the one-time conversion of legacy digest `none` to unset re-reads `where: { digest: 'none' }` after each batch, and its compare-and-set only checks that the row still holds `none`. During the boot pass, a row that newly holds `none` (a new row with an explicit `none`, a member re-picking `none`, or a write from a not-yet-upgraded node in a rolling deploy) is also rewritten to unset, which ruling B item 4 forbids (from then on `none` is a member's real choice). The window is the length of the boot pass. Fix suggested by the review: take the id set before the ledger claim and rewrite only that snapshot, paging by an id cursor instead of re-reading the filter. This also covers the case where the claim fails after the read and the next boot converts a `none` written in between.

**Also on this card (optional, from the same review):**
- The Notification Settings page has no "follow the organization again" action for digest or quiet hours; once a member saves either from the page they cannot return to following the organization from the page (the Setup grid can clear the field). Visible behaviour: the seat decides whether to add it.
- `QUIET_HOURS_OFF` is spelled in both `preference-resolver.ts` and `ui/…/myPreferences.ts` with no pin tying them together.

Done when: S1 converts only the pre-claim snapshot, pinned by a test that writes `none` during the pass and sees it survive (ablation red); the optional items are either done or split off.
